title: Coup of 30 Prairial VII
text: The Coup of 30 Prairial Year VII, also known as the Revenge of the Councils, was a bloodless coup in France that occurred on 16 June 1799. It left Emmanuel-Joseph Sieyès as the dominant figure of the French government, and prefigured the coup of 18 Brumaire that brought Napoleon Bonaparte to power.
